Subject: Regional allocator depletion — Intergrove Labs readout and next steps

Hi Arielle / Carlos —

I wanted to follow up with a concise readout after this morning's degraded performance you observed on your Dedicated capacity in us-west-2. Summary up front: between 08:40–09:05 PST we hit an allocator depletion condition that caused a subset of your reserved nodes to enter a queued state and resulted in increased tail latency for synchronous inference calls. The service did not lose data, but requests were delayed and a few short-lived token-rate errors were surfaced to your app.

What we’re doing now (high level):
- Ops has collected allocator state and kernel metrics and produced a condensed log package (attached).
- We’ve opened JIRA-RED-7891 to track remediation and are running a targeted allocator parameter change in canary.
- We’ll propose a compensatory credit and a short-term routing tweak to reduce your latency exposure while we stabilize.

Ask: Can we schedule a 30-minute readout with your engineering and SRE team today or tomorrow to walk the logs and agree on the route-to-recovery? I’ve CC’d Ben and Laura from Customer Success so they can coordinate credits and schedule.

Attachments: allocator-logs-20261113.tar.gz (log archive)

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Regional allocator depletion — Intergrove Labs readout and next steps

Thanks for the quick note, Stephanie.

We saw ~20% increase in p95 latency and a handful (~12) of 500/429 errors between 08:45–09:02. Those spikes directly impacted our chat inference pipeline; we had to briefly shift traffic to a fallback model.

Two immediate questions:
1) What’s the ETA for the routing tweak? We need something in place before Monday’s marketing push.
2) For the credit — can you share what factors you consider (duration, affected tokens, SLA)? We’ll need details for our finance review.

Available window for a call: today 15:00–16:00 PST or tomorrow 10:00–11:30 PST.

—Arielle
Arielle Chen

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Regional allocator depletion — log package and quick ops notes

Ben / Neha — forwarding the customer thread and the attached logs. Key points from ops triage so far:
- Root trigger: allocator token pool exhaustion when a small fraction of reserved nodes reported a transient kernel selection stall during warmup; allocator backoff heuristics were too aggressive.
- Impact window: 08:40–09:05 PST; roughly 12 failed requests and elevated p95 for ~25 minutes.
- Immediate mitigation (in-flight): reduce allocator backoff + enable a temporary routing rule to overflow low-priority queries to a separate pool.

I’ve uploaded the same logs to our incident Drive (link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/Intergrove-incident-20261113) and created JIRA-RED-7891. Please attach any additional traces you need to that ticket.

Forwarding original attachment: allocator-logs-20261113.tar.gz (log archive)

Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Regional allocator depletion — remediation plan and credit offer

Stephanie / team — brief ops + commercial proposal:

Ops plan (what we will do):
- Today: applied a conservative allocator backoff patch to the us-west-2 canary and throttled warmup concurrency on the affected node group. Monitoring shows p95 returning to normal.
- Next 72 hours: roll patch to full pool during low-traffic window (01:00–03:00 PST) with staged verification.
- Post-roll: add an automated health-check that will trigger routing to spare capacity on future warmup anomalies.

Customer compensation:
- We propose a one-time credit equivalent to 3 days of baseline reservation fees and a $2,000 operational credit to cover engineering validation time. Details attached: intergrove-credit-offer-20261114.pdf

Meeting: we can take the 15:00 PST slot today; I’ll bring the remediation runbook.

JIRA: linked to JIRA-RED-7891.

Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Regional allocator depletion — Intergrove Labs readout and next steps (follow-up)

Hi Arielle / Carlos —

Thanks again for the call today. Short summary and agreed next steps:
- Root cause: transient kernel-selection stall during warmup caused allocator token exhaustion in a subset of nodes.
- Immediate mitigations: allocator backoff patch (rolled to canary), warmup concurrency throttle, and temporary routing overflow to spare pool. Monitoring is green across the affected cluster.
- Roll plan: full roll tonight between 01:00–03:00 PST; we’ll notify you 30 minutes before and run validation tests.
- Credits: Ben shared the one-time credit proposal; finance and your team should have the PDF attached to the meeting invite.
- Action items:
  - Redwood: execute full roll, confirm validation by 04:00 PST Monday, and add automated health-check (owner: Ops).
  - Intergrove: validate your end-to-end tests against canary this week and share any anomalies (owner: Platform SRE).

We’ll keep this ticket open until Monday EOD and follow up with a brief postmortem (timeline + corrective actions) by Wednesday. If you want that earlier, let me know.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
